name: vibe-me-mux
description: Mux plugin: kunwei addon as a standalone repo (editor, greper, runner, reverie, browser, fuzzy, review-loop, caps, syntax-check)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs --external:@kreuzberg/tree-sitter-language-pack --external:@ff-labs/fff-node --external:highlight.js --external:es-module-lexer --define:import.meta.url=__filename && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
